description: This file defines the CachingStream class, a decorator for stream objects that adds caching capabilities to optimize read operations by caching previously read bytes. It implements the StreamInterface from PSR-7 standards and provides methods for reading, seeking, rewinding, and managing stream data with caching logic.

classes.name: CachingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator class that adds caching functionality to an existing stream, allowing previously read bytes to be cached and reused to optimize sequential read operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CachingStream with a source stream and optionally a target cache stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the cached stream if available.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream position to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the stream based on the offset and whence parameter.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, utilizing caching to optimize subsequent reads.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the buffer and manages skip bytes for remote reads.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of both the remote and buffer streams has been reached.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes both the remote and buffer streams.

methods.name: cacheEntireStream
methods.description: Caches the entire stream content into a temporary stream for efficient repeated access.
